patch.value: Add canonical 'pm beads validate' command (was Unknown command)

README and inline docs present 'pm beads validate <file>' as the primary form, but only the hyphenated 'pm beads-validate' was registered. The 'beads' command group gets import/export from the registered importer/exporter, but never had a 'validate' subcommand, so 'pm beads validate items.jsonl' returned 'Unknown command validate'. Fix: add an explicit registerCommand({name:'beads validate'}) mirroring beads-validate's handler (same VALIDATE_FLAGS, runValidate). Both forms now work; extended the smoke test to require the canonical command. Verified end-to-end: valid→rc0, invalid→rc1, --json intact, hyphenated alias preserved, no fork-bomb.

Fix already present in main (registerCommand 'beads validate' at index.ts:1854); re-verified end-to-end against CLI 2026.6.11: 'pm beads validate' valid->rc0, malformed->rc1, hyphenated 'pm beads-validate' alias intact. Closing as shipped.
